title: Free time between meetings
about: Write time parsing, interval merging and free-slot search from their docstrings, edge cases included: touching meetings, meetings outside the day, an inclusive minimum.
task: Implement the functions in slots/times.py and slots/calendar.py as their docstrings specify -- every rule in them, not only what the tests check. `python -m pytest -q` runs the tests. Do not edit anything under tests/. Stop when the tests pass and the implementation follows the docstrings.
